pricing.details: Starter 0 € — 200 AI credits (annual credits per billing cycle), starter AI model and agent, up to 20 slides. Pro 18 €/month billed annually (217 €/year) — 5,000 credits, advanced AI features, high-quality PowerPoint export, presentation tracking and analytics, brand customization. Gold 90 €/month billed annually (1,086 €/year) — 50,000 credits, all Pro features, frontier AI models and agents, advanced brand customization, shared knowledge base.
